title: OpenCV Basics: BGR, dtypes and Indexing
learning_objectives: Convert between OpenCV's BGR order, RGB and greyscale with cv2.cvtColor
Keep images as uint8 arrays and know where OpenCV expects them
Translate OpenCV (x, y) coordinates into NumPy [row, column] indexing
entry_point: to_rgb_and_gray(bgr); crop(image, x, y, w, h)
hints: Rows come first: `image[y:y + h, x:x + w].copy()` after checking `x + w <= width` and `y + h <= height`.

failure_feedback.advice: OpenCV images are BGR: use COLOR_BGR2RGB and COLOR_BGR2GRAY.
Index image[y:y + h, x:x + w] — rows (y) first.
Require uint8 (h, w, 3) images and rectangles inside the image.
